[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
'''John Glasgow''' was christened on '''15 August 1790''' in Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian, Scotland, the son of [[Glasgow-1238|Thomas Glasgow]] and Margaret Chapman<ref>"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-T91 : 12 February 2020), John Glasgow, 1790. Parents: Thomas Glasgow, Margaret Chapman. Christening Date: 15 Aug 1790, Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian, Scotland.</ref>. He had several known siblings also christened in Kirknewton and East Calder: George (1792), James (1794), Thomas (1796, possibly died young), David (1798), and another Thomas (1800).

John married '''Marion Anderson''' (recorded as Marrion) in '''February 1810''' in New Monkland, Lanarkshire<ref>"Scotland, Marriages, 1561-1910", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XT1Q-S8H : 11 February 2020), John Glasgow and Marrion Anderson, Feb 1810, New Monkland, Lanarkshire, Scotland.</ref>. He was 19 years old. This indicates he likely relocated from Midlothian to Lanarkshire sometime before his marriage.

John and Marion had several children born in New Monkland parish, including:
* John Glasgow, born circa 1814 (based on age 45 at marriage). He married Helen Murray in 1859, listing his parents as John Glasgow and Marion Anderson<ref>"Scotland, Civil Registration, 1855-1875, 1881, 1891", FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TFT-ZVM2 : Fri Oct 25 19:00:28 UTC 2024), Entry for John Glasgow (groom, age 45, son of John Glasgow & Marion Anderson) and Helen Murray, marriage 13 May 1859, New Monkland, Lanarkshire, Scotland.</ref>.
* Thomas Leeshman Glasgow, christened 6 October 1822<ref>"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XY7H-7QD : 16 September 2021), John Glasgow in entry for Thomas Leeshman Glasgow, christened 6 Oct 1822, New Monkland, Lanarkshire, Scotland. Parents: John Glasgow, Marrion Anderson.</ref>.
* William Clark Glasgow, christened 19 December 1824<ref>"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTGM-RGS : 16 September 2021), John Glasgow in entry for William Clark Glasgow, christened 19 Dec 1824, New Monkland, Lanarkshire, Scotland. Parents: John Glasgow, Marrion Anderson.</ref>.

FamilySearch records suggest a death date for this John Glasgow of '''11 November 1856'''<ref>Death date stated on FamilySearch profile 9Q4K-C5S (accessed 12 April 2025), specific source citation needed.</ref>. If correct, this would likely be recorded in Scotland's statutory death registers, which began in 1855.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-1620]] is assessed at 98% (proved). John’s 1790 Kirknewton/East Calder baptism names Thomas Glasgow and Margaret Chapman. Thomas-1620’s 1789 marriage to Margaret Chapman in the same parish identifies that exact adult couple before the child.

Recorded 1790 child and Chapman household98%; Thomas’s own earlier parent and John’s later New Monkland identity are separate. Original uninspected.

Next useful test: Compare John’s 1790 child record with the 1810 New Monkland marriage independently.

Source basis already held: [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-T91 "Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-T91 : 12 February 2020), John Glasgow, 1790. Parents: Thomas Glasgow, Margaret Chapman. Christening Date: 15 Aug 1790, Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian, Scotland.]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.


* '''Confirmation of Identity:''' While the connection between John (chr. 1790, son of Thomas/Margaret) and John (husband of Marion Anderson) is maintained based on plausibility and lack of direct contradiction, further evidence like a death record confirming parents would solidify it. The son John's 1859 marriage naming parents John Glasgow and Marion Anderson strongly supports the existence and persistence of the John/Marion family unit.
* '''1841 Census Discrepancy:''' An 1841 census record showing a John Glasgow (age 52) living in Airdrie with wife '''Janet''' (age 55) and a different family structure<ref>"Scotland, Census, 1841", FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VYZ2-WB6 : Tue Jan 21 15:02:57 UTC 2025), Entry for John Glasgow and Janet Glasgow, 1841, Airdrie, Lanarkshire.</ref> is currently attached to the corresponding FamilySearch profile (9Q4K-C5S). This census appears highly unlikely to be for *this* John Glasgow (husband of Marion Anderson) and is probably misattributed. Research should focus on finding the correct 1841 and 1851 census entries for John and '''Marion''' Glasgow, likely in New Monkland/Airdrie.
* '''Children Search Complete?:''' The sources confirm sons John (b.c1814), Thomas L. (b.1822), and William C. (b.1824). Were there other children born between 1810 and 1814, or between 1814 and 1822? Further searches of New Monkland parish registers may be warranted.
* '''Death Record Verification:''' The death date of '''11 November 1856''' needs verification via a primary source. A search on ScotlandsPeople for John Glasgow's death record in 1856, checking for matching details (age, parents' names, spouse's name Marion Anderson if she predeceased him, informant details), is required.
* '''Disambiguation:''' This John Glasgow (son of Thomas/Margaret, husband of Marion, associated with Kirknewton & New Monkland) must be distinguished from other contemporary John Glasgows, particularly [[Glasgow-3051|John Glasgow (abt.1791-)]] (husband of Janet Gemmill, associated with Kilmarnock) and potentially the John Glasgow listed in the misattributed 1841 census with wife Janet in Airdrie.
